select * from t_exper_class order by class_code
select c.class_id,c.class_name from t_exper_class c join t_exper_members m on c.class_id = m.class_id where m.user_id = ? order by class_code

#if($experId && !$experId.equals("")) and exper_id =#[experId] #end
#if($docType && !$docType.equals("")) #if($docType.equals("0")) and plan_doc is not null #end #if(!$docType.equals("1")) and report_doc is not null #end #end

#if($experId && !$experId.equals("")) and exper_id =#[experId] #end

INSERT INTO t_exper_person (exper_id,exper_name,operat_user,group_id,team_id,country_ab,start_time,end_time,cost_time,operat_score,report_score,total_socre,remark) SELECT a.exper_id,a.exper_name,a.user_account,a.group_id,a.team_id,a.country_ab,a.start_time,a.end_time,a.cost_time,a.operat_socre,a.report_socre,a.total_socre,a.remark FROM (select distinct n.*,m.user_account,d.report_socre from t_exper_members m join t_exper_main n on m.in_group = n.group_id left join t_exper_doc d on d.exper_id = n.exper_id where n.exper_id = #[experId]) a
